what: pqc — the drawing half of /instruments/pqc, ported verbatim from frontier-apps tools/pqc-app.js. Two views on one instrument: the LLL reduction animated (141 snapshots, profile as a ratio of exact Gram determinants) and the wall (926 records against 1.05). Canvas 2D; every dash is a heuristic that was asserted, every solid mark was decided.
rule: Byte-for-byte; the builder beside it is the house port of tools/build-pqc.js. The records it draws are instruments/pqc/out/*.json, pinned and re-derived there.
patches: pqc-app.js (2026-10-30, the operator's ruling that the instruments take the light theme): ink() and the strip's backing box read the --ink and --bg tokens through playground/design/theme.js (window.WTHEME) instead of the literals rgba(246,246,248,a) and rgba(10,10,12,.72), which are those tokens' dark values, so dark paints the same colours; and the view is drawn again, from the state held, when the reader flips the theme pill. Presentation only: no number, record, rule or decision moved. The pin at the lift is kept as sha256AtLift.
